items.title: FDA Permits Expanded Access for Investigational Pancreatic Cancer Drug
items.summary: FDA is announcing that it issued a “safe to proceed” letter to Revolution Medicines, allowing the sponsor to initiate an expanded access treatment protocol (EAP) for its experimental pancreatic cancer drug, daraxonrasib.

items.title: Decision: Medical devices given exceptional use authorisations
items.summary: List of manufacturers and their medical devices granted an exemption by MHRA. The list also includes manufacturers whose exemption expired or was cancelled.

items.title: Obesity and Drug Dosing: Clinical Pharmacology Considerations; Request for Comments
items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is establishing a public docket entitled "Obesity and Drug Dosing: Clinical Pharmacology Considerations." The Agency is soliciting input from interested persons on assessing the effect of obesity on drug pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics during drug (including biological product) development. These assessments could potentially inform whether obesity impacts the safety and effectiveness of the drug and dosing recommendations for obese…

items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is announcing its intent to exempt from premarket notification requirements certain class II clinical toxicology test system devices. FDA is publishing this notice and requesting public comment in accordance with procedures established by the 21st Century Cures Act. items.title: FDA Approves First Non-Antipsychotic Drug to Treat Agitation Associated with Dementia
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved an expanded use for Auvelity (dextromethorphan hydrobromide and bupropion hydrochloride) extended-release tablets to treat agitation associated with dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease in adults.

items.title: FDA Proposes to Exclude Semaglutide, Tirzepatide, and Liraglutide on 503B Bulks List
items.summary: FDA is proposing to exclude semaglutide, tirzepatide, and liraglutide from the 503B bulks list, finding no clinical need for outsourcing facilities to compound these drugs from bulk substances.

items.title: Guidance: The Innovative Devices Access Pathway (IDAP)
items.summary: The Innovative Devices Access Pathway (IDAP) pilot is designed to accelerate the development of innovative medical devices that meet an unmet clinical need in the NHS and support their integration into the UK market.

items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing an opportunity for public comment on the proposed collection of certain information by the Agency. Under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (PRA), Federal Agencies are required to publish notice in the Federal Register concerning each proposed collection of information, including each proposed extension of an existing collection of information, and to allow 60 days for public comment in response to the notice. items.title: MHRA hires top global tech talent to transform systems behind regulation of medicines and medical devices
items.summary: The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) is pleased to announce the appointment of Jason Bonander as its new Chief Digital and Technology Officer (CDTO).

items.title: MHRA Safety Roundup: April 2026
items.summary: Summary of the latest safety advice for medicines and medical device users

items.title: FDA Releases Results from Largest-Ever Testing of Infant Formula in the U.S.
items.summary: FDA announces results from the largest and most rigorous examination ever conducted focused on chemical contaminants in infant formula available on the U.S. market.

items.title: FDA Announces Major Steps to Implement Real-Time Clinical Trials
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today announced two major steps as part of an initiative to advance the implementation of real-time clinical trials (RTCT).

items.title: Precautionary recall of antidepressant medication due to manufacturing error
items.summary: The MHRA has advised healthcare professionals to stop supplying the affected batch of Sertraline 100mg and return all remaining stock to their suppliers.

items.title: Clinical investigations for medical devices
items.summary: How to notify the MHRA of your intention to carry out a clinical investigation for medical devices.

items.title: Class 2 Medicines Recall: Amarox Limited, Sertraline 100mg film-coated tablets, EL(26)A/22
items.summary: Amarox Limited is recalling one batch of Sertraline 100 mg film-coated tablets as a precautionary measure due to an error at the manufacturing site.

items.title: FDA Accelerates Action on Treatments for Serious Mental Illness Following Executive Order
items.summary: On April 18, President Trump issued an Executive Order directing the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) to accelerate access to treatments for patients with serious mental illness, including devastating, complex, and treatment-resistant conditions.

items.title: FDA Approves First-Ever Gene Therapy for Treatment of Genetic Hearing Loss Under National Priority Voucher Program
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved Otarmeni (lunsotogene parvec-cwha), the first-ever dual adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector-based gene therapy.

items.title: CMS and FDA Announce RAPID Coverage Pathway to Accelerate Patient Access to Life-Changing Medical Devices
items.summary: CMS and FDA announce the Regulatory Alignment for Predictable and Immediate Device (RAPID) coverage pathway, a new pathway designed to expedite access to certain FDA-designated Class II and Class III Breakthrough Devices for people with Medicare.

items.title: FDA Achieves Year 1 Goals in Reducing Animal Testing in Drug Development
items.summary: Since publishing roadmap last April, agency has successfully launched several key initiatives to replace animal testing with better alternatives

items.title: FDA Takes Step Forward on Testosterone Therapy for Men
items.summary: FDA is taking an initial step to advance treatment options for men’s health by encouraging sponsors of approved testosterone replacement therapy products to contact FDA for information if they are interested in pursuing a potential new indication for low libido in men with idiopathic hypogonadism.

items.title: FDA Issues Draft Guidance on Genome Editing Safety Standards to Advance Gene Therapy Development
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today issued a draft guidance for sponsors seeking approval of human gene therapy products involving genome editing technologies.

items.title: FDA Reminds More Than 2,200 Sponsors and Researchers to Disclose Trial Results
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has reminded more than 2,200 medical product companies and researchers of the requirements to submit certain clinical trial results information to ClinicalTrials.gov.

items.title: FDA Approves First New Molecular Entity Under National Priority Voucher Program
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved Foundayo (orforglipron) marking the fifth approval under the Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (CNPV) pilot program.

items.title: FDA Approves First Gene Therapy for Severe Leukocyte Adhesion Deficiency Type I
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today approved Kresladi (marnetegragene autotemcel), the first gene therapy for the treatment of severe Leukocyte Adhesion Deficiency Type I (LAD-I).

items.title: FDA Approves Drug to Treat Neurologic Manifestations of Hunter Syndrome
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Avlayah (tividenofusp alfa-eknm) to treat certain individuals with Hunter syndrome (Mucopolysaccharidosis type II or MPS II).
